Ensigns brings ten colour families into one catalogue. Each declares its purpose and the environments in which it is measured. The site shows both modes, specimens, reports and ready-made downloads.

The Carpenter exports to 29 formats in the browser, including editors, terminals, publishing tools, chart libraries, web frameworks and palette files. Comparisons and a contrast checker help choose a ground. No account or upload is required.

The repository holds one source of colour, shared by the site, export writers and local packages. Code is MIT. Tokens, generated colour values and documentation are CC BY 4.0. Fonts and third-party templates retain their licences.

[Source](https://github.com/tiagojct/ensigns) · [Release instructions](https://github.com/tiagojct/ensigns/blob/main/docs/RELEASE.md)
